label: Signal Pool (leads that grow taller with every signal)
description: A POOL OF LEADS where height is the score: each lead is a sticker standing on a column of SIGNAL slips -- one activity-log row per brand interaction (a coloured dot, the signal in real words, a time). A signal landing at its `at` slides in under the lead and lifts him, so the more signals, the taller he stands and the more he sticks out of the crowd. `peel` takes his newest signals off again (he shrinks back into the pool), `badge` sticks a sticker on him (an MQL seal), `moves` carries him out of the pool and back, `count` keeps a running 'N signals' tally over his head. Each lead publishes data-anchor 'lead-<id>' for camera moves. A signal with at <= 0 is already in his log at frame 0, so the next scene can pick the pool up exactly where the last one left it. Example: {"leads":[{"id":"star","sticker":"q-lead-warm","label":"the lead","count":true,"signals":[{"at":1.2,"kind":"email","text":"Opened email: Q4 playbook","time":"Mon"},{"at":2.4,"kind":"web","text":"Landed on /pricing","time":"Tue"}]},{"id":"p2","sticker":"q-prospect-2","signals":[{"at":3,"kind":"social","text":"Liked a LinkedIn post"}]}]}.

sticker.label: Sticker name from the library (e.g. q-lead-warm)

enter_at.label: Drops into the pool at (s); 0 = already there

count.label: Show a running 'N signals' tally over him

at.label: Lands at (s); <= 0 = already in his log

peel.label: Newest signals peel off and flutter away

badge.label: A sticker that sticks on him (e.g. q-mql-badge)

moves.label: Moves of the whole lead (column and all), in box fractions

dx.label: Offset x (fraction of the box width, from where he stands)

dy.label: Offset y (fraction of the box height)

pool.label: Draw the pool under them (default true)
